readout_other: sucrose preference test; forced swim test; open field test; cortical neurotransmitters by LC-MS/MS; fecal metagenomics and tryptophan metabolites; HE staining
direction_notes: Protocol 2 (PRF 1.5 kHz) increased sucrose preference, reduced FST immobility and raised cortical glutamate versus sham in CUMS mice; Protocol 1 (PRF 300 Hz) had no significant effect.
safety_notes: HE staining after two weeks of stimulation showed no histopathological damage or hemorrhage in the prelimbic cortex (LIFUS2 protocol).

exposures.label: LIFUS1 (300 Hz PRF) and LIFUS2 (1.5 kHz PRF)

timing.protocol_description: Two protocols: Protocol 1 (PRF 300 Hz, PD 400 us, DC 12%, ISPTA 0.26 W/cm2) and Protocol 2 (PRF 1.5 kHz, PD 400 us, DC 60%, ISPTA 1.31 W/cm2). Both used a sonication duration of 400 ms with 3-second inter-stimulus intervals; each stimulation session lasted 15 minutes, daily, for about two weeks.

source_quotes.n_subjects: To evaluate the antidepressant-like effects of ultrasound stimulation with different parameters, CUMS mice were allocated into a sham stimulation group (SHAM, n=8) and two active stimulation groups with distinct parameters (LIFUS1, n=8; LIFUS2, n=8), with each group comprising 4 male and 4 female mice, and compared against a control group (CON, n=8).

flags.reason: Second PRF (1.5 kHz) taken from Protocol 2 text; quote given is Protocol 1 sentence; Protocol 2 is in the PRF figure legend and the same paragraph as LaTeX.
ISPTA given without stating water or in-brain domain.
n=8 per group for LIFUS1 and LIFUS2 (16 sonicated); sham group (n=8, no output) and CON/CUMS not counted; some assays had smaller n.
Sham was amplifier switched off, said to control for procedural noise and equipment sounds; no dedicated auditory control described.
Daily 15-min sessions for 'two weeks' of stimulation; number of sessions not stated.
Prelimbic cortex mapped to ventromedial_prefrontal_cortex (medial prefrontal).
Behavioural improvement with PRF 1.5 kHz only; direction of neural effect not directly assessed except cortical glutamate increase.
